step-1.text: Stand one side panel on its edge, holes facing in. Butt the bottom board against it and drive two screws through the side into the board. Snug, not stripped.

count-1.text: This step uses 1 side panel, 1 top and bottom and 2 screws.

step-2.text: Screw the four long shelves to the same side, two screws each. The holes set the cubby height, so just follow them.

count-2.text: This step uses 4 long shelves and 8 screws.

step-3.text: Tap a dowel into each divider hole, then press the ten short dividers in between the boards, two per row. Push each one fully home so the cubbies stay square.

count-3.text: This step uses 10 dividers and 10 wood dowels.

step-4.text: Set the top board over the last row of dividers and screw it to the side panel.

count-4.text: This step uses 1 top and bottom and 2 screws.

step-5.text: With a helper steadying it, line the second side up with every board end and screw it on, top to bottom. Then check each cubby is square before the screws bite.

count-5.text: This step uses 1 side panel and 12 screws.

step-6.text: Fit the anti-tip kit to the back of the top, then fix it to the wall with fixings for your wall. Kids climb cubbies. Always anchor it.

done.text: Done. Your SLEEKLINE 15-cubby storage 5×3 is built. Give it a proud little pat.
